dossier.architecture: Compact pivoting telescope and wristed roller end effector on swerve.

subsystems.intake: Dead-axle rollers acquire both pieces; different poses cover upright cones, tipped cones, floor cubes and shelf loading.
subsystems.transfer: Direct end-effector acquisition with no separate magazine.
subsystems.scoring: Two-stage telescoping arm, shoulder pivot and wrist provide reach while keeping the stowed package low.
subsystems.endgame: Interview describes three-piece autonomous plus balance; no special station attachment is established here.
subsystems.controls: Tuned joint controllers, selectable piece/level presets, home/brake setup buttons and modular waypoint-to-waypoint autonomous sequences.

versions: Multiple end-effector iterations reported; individual shapes not all distinguished.
Public release adds CAD and technical binder references for further inspection.
dossier.analysis: The transferable lesson is coordinated reach and rapid autonomous iteration. Their extended acquisition reach reduces chassis travel, but depends on accurate joints and consistent homing.
limits: Full season timeline and endgame attachment status require corroboration.

context_documents.title: 2023-2910 · A compact telescoping package still needs piece-specific poses
context_documents.body:
# 2023-2910: A compact telescoping package still needs piece-specific poses

Focused study supplement. Not a full binder/CAD review, exhaustive subsystem specification, every-version history or visual interview watch.

## Published / retained construction account

A two-stage telescoping arm, shoulder and wrist provide grid reach while stowing low. The source demonstrates distinct floor-cube, tipped-cone, upright-cone and shelf-acquisition poses using dead-axis roller contacts.

## Team-stated reasoning or boundary

The stated objectives are speed, compactness, all-level reach and low center of gravity.

## Engineering interpretation — analyst inference

One gripper does not imply one acquisition state. The arm and wrist jointly create the contact conditions for each piece, while extension changes torque and clearance. A copied roller layout without those poses and transitions is incomplete.

## Proposed validation — not performed

Validate every acquisition pose and the connecting paths, then measure loaded settle time at maximum reach.

## Limits

Focused technical passages and the retained dossier are the evidence scope. Exact event installation, complete CAD tolerances and all intermediate revisions are not certified.

## Sources and navigation

- [https://youtu.be/7ETEf__nD1I](https://youtu.be/7ETEf__nD1I)
- [https://www.chiefdelphi.com/t/436653](https://www.chiefdelphi.com/t/436653)
